entries.name: Nero Voice
entries.summary: Dictation, meeting transcripts and a place to return to the conversation.
entries.detail: Hold your chosen shortcut, speak and release to paste into the active app. The meeting workspace brings recordings, transcripts, cited questions and notes together. Apple Speech remains the default where appropriate; separately prepared local MLX models are optional.
capabilities: Microphone and optional meeting audio capture
Accessibility for insertion into the active application
Plugin-owned recordings, transcripts and settings
entries.releaseNotes: Public release qualification is ongoing. This listing describes the current developer preview.

entries.name: Nero Agent
entries.summary: A persistent conversation, with context you choose to share.
entries.detail: A separate chat experience for asking questions, inspecting selected context and proposing actions. Account connections and cloud reasoning belong to this plugin. Proposals and execution remain distinct.
capabilities: Plugin-owned account connection
User-selected context and reviewed actions
entries.releaseNotes: Public release qualification is ongoing. This listing describes the current developer preview.

entries.name: Fuego Agent
entries.summary: Hand off a job. Follow its progress. Keep the result close.
entries.detail: Connect your own Fuego account, review a job handoff and follow progress and cancellation in the Nook. Workflows can wait for jobs to finish. Requires access to a configured Fuego service and worker; NeroNook does not bundle the Fuego runtime.
capabilities: Plugin-owned Fuego sign-in
Reviewed remote jobs, progress, cancellation and results

dependencies.name: Fuego
dependencies.detail: Your configured Fuego service and worker.

entries.releaseNotes: Public release qualification is ongoing. This listing describes the current developer preview.

entries.name: Bambu Monitor
entries.summary: Your print, filament and toolheads, within reach.
entries.detail: The public Bambu module is an independent integration for supported printers. Device access, telemetry and camera availability depend on your printer configuration. Private experimental variants are not part of this library.
capabilities: Local printer connection with plugin-owned credentials
Printer status and configuration-dependent views
entries.releaseNotes: Public release qualification is ongoing. This listing describes the current developer preview.

entries.name: Stream Deck
entries.summary: Put your Nook workflows on the keys you already use.
entries.detail: Connects through the Elgato Stream Deck application and a companion plugin. Launch reviewed workflows and follow their status on the keys, with a paired Stop action. This integration does not replace Elgato’s application.
capabilities: Local companion connection
Granted workflow launch, live status and cancellation

dependencies.name: Elgato Stream Deck
dependencies.detail: The native Stream Deck app and NeroNook companion are required.

entries.releaseNotes: Public release qualification is ongoing. This listing describes the current developer preview.

entries.name: Logitech
entries.summary: A useful home for your mouse, keyboard and desk workflows.
entries.detail: Connects to OpenLogi’s public interface for supported Logitech hardware. Mouse and keyboard views stay separate from setup. Optional keyboard events can participate in reviewed workflows.
capabilities: OpenLogi public API connection
Supported mouse and keyboard controls
Opt-in keyboard connection and battery events

dependencies.name: OpenLogi
dependencies.detail: A compatible installed OpenLogi app and agent are required.

entries.releaseNotes: Public release qualification is ongoing. This listing describes the current developer preview.

entries.name: Odyssey Ark
entries.summary: Samsung monitor controls that belong right on your desk.
entries.detail: Independent local-network controls for supported Samsung Odyssey Ark monitors. Pairing, certificate trust and source mappings belong to the plugin. Optional Logitech source following needs both independent modules and explicit configuration.
capabilities: Local monitor pairing and plugin-owned credentials
Supported monitor volume and source controls
entries.releaseNotes: Public release qualification is ongoing. This listing describes the current developer preview.

entries.name: Weather Observatory
entries.summary: Forecasts, wind, temperature and a wider view of the weather.
entries.detail: An independent weather module with a location-aware forecast and selectable Earth and optional Windy map views. No separate desktop app is required. Windy requires your own API entitlement; Earth’s viewer availability depends on its service.
capabilities: Optional location permission or manual place selection
Weather-provider network requests
Optional plugin-owned Windy API key
entries.releaseNotes: Public release qualification is ongoing. This listing describes the current developer preview.

entries.name: Home Assistant
entries.summary: Favorites, rooms and scenes. Control what you choose.
entries.detail: An independent connection to your Home Assistant server. Start read only, then individually allow lights, switches and scenes. Native and in-Nook controls review their targets; locks, doors, climate and security are read only in this release. No separate desktop application is required.
capabilities: Plugin-owned Home Assistant token
Live home inventory and individually allowed device controls

dependencies.name: Home Assistant server
dependencies.detail: Your own running server and a token you provide in the plugin.

entries.releaseNotes: Public release qualification is ongoing. This listing describes the current developer preview.

entries.name: Apple Home
entries.summary: Keep your selected home and its accessories close.
entries.detail: A separate Apple Home integration. Requires a compatible Apple Home setup and the permissions supported by the plugin. Account and accessory availability are checked independently of NeroNook.
capabilities: Apple Home access for your selected home
entries.releaseNotes: Public release qualification is ongoing. This listing describes the current developer preview.

entries.name: Google
entries.summary: Calendar, inbox, tasks and files, with room to work.
entries.detail: A plugin-owned Google account connection with separate views for calendar events, mail, tasks and files. OAuth registration, consent and account coverage remain part of its independent release qualification.
capabilities: User-approved Google OAuth scopes
Calendar, inbox, task and file views
entries.releaseNotes: Public release qualification is ongoing. This listing describes the current developer preview.

entries.name: Creator Beta Demo
entries.summary: An independent local demo module built with the NeroNook creator kit.
entries.detail: A synthetic native creator example: a shared counter, inline review, a custom view and an independent window. It does not connect to accounts or devices. Useful for trying installation and learning the SDK.
capabilities: Shows local demo state and changes a demo counter
Publishes read-only demo status through the shared SDK
entries.releaseNotes: First curated library release. Install and update only after reviewing the package.

entries.name: Hello Nook
entries.summary: Your first module: a greeting and counter shared across monitors.
entries.detail: A small, local greeting and counter in the isolated module runner. An easy first install and an editable starting point for lightweight module authors.
entries.releaseNotes: First curated library release. Install and update only after reviewing the package.
